text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia briefs President Liamine Zeroual on results of his visit to Tunisia.
- Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf told the Transitional National Council Algeria is ready to help resolving Western Sahara conflict.
- Private business representatives meet over unifying their organisations.
- University teachers' union and ministry officials to discuss pay increase claimed by the union.
- Opposition Socialist Forces Front to sue Algiers governor over banning a planned march protest in the city.
- Housing Minister Kamel Hakimi postpones talks with workers' representatives over due salaries and enterprises' debt.
- University teachers plan to stage street protests in Algiers if talks between their union and the ministry fail to satisfy demands over pay.
